messages:
Maya: hey team! I'm Maya (started today on infra). I'm blocked: when I try to open the Redwood Console staging it says 'No role assigned' and I can't access the feature flag admin. Who should I ping to get staging/admin + FF toggles? My Okta email: maya@redwood.ai :wave:
Samir: welcome Maya! @Olivia and @Jordan usually handle FF roles. I'll try to grant a temp staging-admin for 2 weeks. Can you confirm your manager? Also what's your Okta email (exact spelling)?
Maya: thanks Samir! Manager is Samir R. Email is maya@redwood.ai (lowercase). Need it mainly for running canary tests and verifying KV cache behavior.
Olivia: hi Maya — welcome! For feature flag admin we use the 'featureflag-admin' entitlement in Okta. I can't grant prod FF access without signed training. For staging I can add you now. Fill this short form: https://intra.redwood/ff-onboard (internal). Also please include 'onboarding/maya' in audit notes.
Jordan: If you plan to flip flags as part of tests, please use the sandbox environment first. Quick curl to check your flag state from the API (replace TOKEN):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" https://api.staging.redwood/flags/status?flag=fastpath
```
Don't toggle prod flags after 9am PST without a rollout note. :warning: 
Devops-bot: Request created: INFRA-3421 by Samir for maya@redwood.ai — provisioning staging-admin (2 weeks).
Okta-bot: Okta ticket OKTA-8932 created. Awaiting approval from security.
Samir: Thanks — I added the justification (onboarding + canary tests). @Olivia if you can approve the FF entitlement that'd be great.
Olivia: Approved. featureflag-admin granted for staging. Please confirm when you can access.
Devops-bot: Provisioned staging-admin role for maya@redwood.ai at 1778901299.
Maya: I can access staging console and see the FF panel. Thanks everyone! I'll follow the sandbox flow and add audit note 'onboarding/maya' when I toggle anything.
Samir: awesome — welcome aboard :tada: Ping here if you hit anything else.
